headerDisplay: Controls Mitsubishi Electric air conditioners registered on **MELCloud Home** (melcloudhome.com). This is the newer platform used by 4th-generation Wi-Fi adapters — if your units are on the older `app.melcloud.com` service, use a legacy MELCloud plugin instead.
footerDisplay: Your credentials are sent only to Mitsubishi's own identity provider and are never written to disk. Access tokens are cached under the Homebridge storage directory so restarts do not require a fresh sign-in.

email.title: Email
email.description: The email address for your MELCloud Home account.

password.title: Password
password.description: The password for your MELCloud Home account.

pollInterval.title: Poll interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: How often to poll for state. Values below 30 seconds risk rate limiting and are clamped.

useWebSocket.title: Real-time updates
useWebSocket.description: Subscribe to the platform's push feed so changes made from a remote or the MELCloud Home app appear within seconds. Polling continues as a fallback.

exposeFanService.title: Expose airflow as a Fan accessory
exposeFanService.description: Adds fan speed, automatic fan speed and swing to each unit. The Home app does not render these on a Heater Cooler, so without this they cannot be reached natively. It folds into the same control as the climate one rather than appearing separately. Turning it on makes the separate automatic-fan-speed switch redundant.

exposeTemperatureSensors.title: Expose temperature sensors
exposeTemperatureSensors.description: Add a separate temperature sensor per unit. The Heater Cooler already reports room temperature, so this is a duplicate reading — enable it only if you want a distinct sensor for automations or history. It also carries the fault and connectivity status, which a Heater Cooler cannot.

exposeDrySwitch.title: Expose Dry mode switch
exposeDrySwitch.description: Dry mode has no HomeKit equivalent, so it is offered as a separate switch. Adds another control to the accessory.

exposeFanSwitch.title: Expose Fan mode switch
exposeFanSwitch.description: Fan-only mode has no HomeKit equivalent, so it is offered as a separate switch. Adds another control to the accessory.

exposeAutoFanSwitch.title: Expose automatic fan speed switch
exposeAutoFanSwitch.description: The HomeKit fan slider has no automatic position, so it is offered as a separate switch. Redundant when the fan service is enabled, which exposes automatic fan speed natively.

exposeEnergy.title: Expose energy telemetry (not yet implemented)
exposeEnergy.description: Reserved for a future release — enabling this currently does nothing. The telemetry endpoint is known, but its response shape has not been captured, and units reporting isEnergyUsageCompatible: false are unlikely to return usable data at all.

debug.title: Verbose logging
debug.description: Log the full request trace. Credentials, tokens and authorization codes are always redacted.
